answer: Neighbor-quorum bond: each identity locks 70 credits, registering timber at an oasis registry. Five neighbors co-sign, 25 each. A gale beacon calls one tenth each epoch to show five endorsements in one hour. Auditors check the registry; reused signers forfeit bond and stakes. At most two per neighbor, so 1,000 fakes need 2,500 neighbors, pay 125,000, lock 70,000, against a 40,000 pool. Rented-signature rings lose all. Honest ones pay 125 once.
